x-kubernetes-validations.message: At least one repository must be configured when backups are enabled
cannot change PGDATA path: config_file, data_directory
cannot change external_pid_file
cannot change authentication path: hba_file, ident_file
network connectivity is always enabled: listen_addresses
change port using .spec.port instead
TLS is always enabled
domain socket paths cannot be changed
wal_level must be "replica" or higher
wal_log_hints are always enabled
hot_standby is always enabled
delayed replication is not supported at this time
cluster_name is derived from the PostgresCluster name
disabling logging_collector is unsafe
log_file_mode cannot be changed
CRVersion must be a valid semantic version
vault is required for enabling pg_tde
pg_tde must be enabled to enable WAL encryption
to disable pg_tde first set enabled=false without removing vault and wait for pod restarts
certManagementPolicy is immutable
pg_tde is only supported for PG16 and above
PostgresVersion must be >= 15 if grantPublicSchemaAccess exists and is true
spec.logicalReplicas requires spec.postgresVersion >= 17
spec.logicalReplicas[].bootstrapMethod must be 'pg_basebackup' when spec.backups.enabled is false
